main.description: Sets the requesting user's off-protocol presence. An absent field leaves the current value unchanged.

text.description: The status text. An empty string clears it. Absent leaves the current value unchanged.

emoji.description: A Unicode emoji shown beside the status. An empty string clears it. Absent leaves the current value unchanged.

customEmoji.description: A custom emoji shown beside the status. The uri must name an emoji item record. Absent leaves the current value unchanged. Takes precedence over removeCustomEmoji.

removeCustomEmoji.description: Removes the custom emoji. Ignored when customEmoji is also given.

expiresAt.description: When the status clears. Absent leaves the current value unchanged. Takes precedence over removeExpiresAt.

removeExpiresAt.description: Removes the status expiry, so the status stays until it is changed. Ignored when expiresAt is also given.

showWhileOffline.description: Whether a client shows the status while the user is offline. Absent leaves the current value unchanged.

onlineState.description: Derived online state. Absent leaves the current value unchanged.

presence.description: The requesting user's presence, after the update.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: The request has no valid service auth.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: A field is present but does not hold an allowed value.
